record.bible_text: Moreover the word<WH01697> of the LORD<WH03068> came unto me, saying<WH0559><WTH8800>,

Now, thou son<WH01121> of man<WH0120>, wilt thou judge<WH08199><WTH8799>, wilt thou judge<WH08199><WTH8799> the bloody<WH01818> city<WH05892>? yea, thou shalt shew<WH03045><WTH8689> her all her abominations<WH08441>. <RF>judge: or, plead for<Rf> <RF>bloody...: Heb. city of bloods?<Rf> <RF>shew her: Heb. make her know<Rf>

Then say<WH0559><WTH8804> thou, Thus saith<WH0559><WTH8804> the Lord<WH0136> GOD<WH03069>, The city<WH05892> sheddeth<WH08210><WTH8802> blood<WH01818> in the midst<WH08432> of it, that her time<WH06256> may come<WH0935><WTH8800>, and maketh<WH06213><WTH8804> idols<WH01544> against herself to defile<WH02930><WTH8800> herself.

Thou art become guilty<WH0816><WTH8804> in thy blood<WH01818> that thou hast shed<WH08210><WTH8804>; and hast defiled<WH02930><WTH8804> thyself in thine idols<WH01544> which thou hast made<WH06213><WTH8804>; and thou hast caused thy days<WH03117> to draw near<WH07126><WTH8686>, and art come<WH0935><WTH8799> <FI>even<Fi> unto thy years<WH08141>: therefore have I made<WH05414><WTH8804> thee a reproach<WH02781> unto the heathen<WH01471>, and a mocking<WH07048> to all countries<WH0776>.

<FI> Those that be<Fi> near<WH07138>, and <FI>those that be<Fi> far<WH07350> from thee, shall mock<WH07046><WTH8691> thee, <FI>which art<Fi> infamous<WH02931><WH08034> <FI>and<Fi> much<WH07227> vexed<WH04103>. <RF>infamous...: Heb. polluted of name, much in vexation<Rf>
Behold, the princes<WH05387> of Israel<WH03478>, every one<WH0376> were in thee to their power<WH02220> to shed<WH08210><WTH8800> blood<WH01818>. <RF>power: Heb. arm<Rf>

In thee have they set light<WH07043><WTH8689> by father<WH01> and mother<WH0517>: in the midst<WH08432> of thee have they dealt<WH06213><WTH8804> by oppression<WH06233> with the stranger<WH01616>: in thee have they vexed<WH03238><WTH8689> the fatherless<WH03490> and the widow<WH0490>. <RF>oppression: or, deceit<Rf>
Thou hast despised<WH0959><WTH8804> mine holy things<WH06944>, and hast profaned<WH02490><WTH8765> my sabbaths<WH07676>.

In thee are men<WH0582> that carry tales<WH07400> to shed<WH08210><WTH8800> blood<WH01818>: and in thee they eat<WH0398><WTH8804> upon the mountains<WH02022>: in the midst<WH08432> of thee they commit<WH06213><WTH8804> lewdness<WH02154>. <RF>that...: Heb. of slanders<Rf>
In thee have they discovered<WH01540><WTH8765> their fathers<WH01>' nakedness<WH06172>: in thee have they humbled<WH06031><WTH8765> her that was set apart<WH05079> for pollution<WH02931>.

And one<WH0376> hath committed<WH06213><WTH8804> abomination<WH08441> with his neighbour's<WH07453> wife<WH0802>; and another<WH0376> hath lewdly<WH02154> defiled<WH02930><WTH8765> his daughter in law<WH03618>; and another<WH0376> in thee hath humbled<WH06031><WTH8765> his sister<WH0269>, his father's<WH01> daughter<WH01323>. <RF>one: or, every one<Rf> <RF>another: or, every one<Rf> <RF>lewdly: or, by lewdness<Rf>

In thee have they taken<WH03947><WTH8804> gifts<WH07810> to shed<WH08210><WTH8800> blood<WH01818>; thou hast taken<WH03947><WTH8804> usury<WH05392> and increase<WH08636>, and thou hast greedily gained<WH01214><WTH8762> of thy neighbours<WH07453> by extortion<WH06233>, and hast forgotten<WH07911><WTH8804> me, saith<WH05002><WTH8803> the Lord<WH0136> GOD<WH03069>.

Behold, therefore I have smitten<WH05221><WTH8689> mine hand<WH03709> at thy dishonest gain<WH01215> which thou hast made<WH06213><WTH8804>, and at thy blood<WH01818> which hath been in the midst<WH08432> of thee.

Can thine heart<WH03820> endure<WH05975><WTH8799>, or can thine hands<WH03027> be strong<WH02388><WTH8799>, in the days<WH03117> that I shall deal<WH06213><WTH8802> with thee? I the LORD<WH03068> have spoken<WH01696><WTH8765> <FI>it<Fi> , and will do<WH06213><WTH8804> <FI>it<Fi> .

And I will scatter<WH06327><WTH8689> thee among the heathen<WH01471>, and disperse<WH02219><WTH8765> thee in the countries<WH0776>, and will consume<WH08552><WTH8689> thy filthiness<WH02932> out of thee.

And thou shalt take thine inheritance<WH02490><WTH8738><WTH8676><WH05157><WTH8765> in thyself in the sight<WH05869> of the heathen<WH01471>, and thou shalt know<WH03045><WTH8804> that I <FI>am<Fi> the LORD<WH03068>. <RF>shalt take...: or, shalt be profaned<Rf><CM>
And the word<WH01697> of the LORD<WH03068> came unto me, saying<WH0559><WTH8800>,

Son<WH01121> of man<WH0120>, the house<WH01004> of Israel<WH03478> is to me become dross<WH05509>: all they <FI>are<Fi> brass<WH05178>, and tin<WH0913>, and iron<WH01270>, and lead<WH05777>, in the midst<WH08432> of the furnace<WH03564>; they are <FI>even<Fi> the dross<WH05509> of silver<WH03701>. <RF>dross of silver: Heb. drosses, etc<Rf>

Therefore thus saith<WH0559><WTH8804> the Lord<WH0136> GOD<WH03069>; Because ye are all become dross<WH05509>, behold, therefore I will gather<WH06908><WTH8802> you into the midst<WH08432> of Jerusalem<WH03389>.

<FI> As<Fi> they gather<WH06910> silver<WH03701>, and brass<WH05178>, and iron<WH01270>, and lead<WH05777>, and tin<WH0913>, into the midst<WH08432> of the furnace<WH03564>, to blow<WH05301><WTH8800> the fire<WH0784> upon it, to melt<WH05413><WTH8687> <FI>it<Fi> ; so will I gather<WH06908><WTH8799> <FI>you<Fi> in mine anger<WH0639> and in my fury<WH02534>, and I will leave<WH03240><WTH8689> <FI>you there<Fi> , and melt<WH05413><WTH8689> you. <RF>As...: Heb. According to the gathering<Rf>
Yea, I will gather<WH03664><WTH8765> you, and blow<WH05301><WTH8804> upon you in the fire<WH0784> of my wrath<WH05678>, and ye shall be melted<WH05413><WTH8738> in the midst<WH08432> thereof.

As silver<WH03701> is melted<WH02046> in the midst<WH08432> of the furnace<WH03564>, so shall ye be melted<WH05413><WTH8714> in the midst<WH08432> thereof; and ye shall know<WH03045><WTH8804> that I the LORD<WH03068> have poured out<WH08210><WTH8804> my fury<WH02534> upon you.<CM>
And the word<WH01697> of the LORD<WH03068> came unto me, saying<WH0559><WTH8800>,

Son<WH01121> of man<WH0120>, say<WH0559><WTH8798> unto her, Thou <FI>art<Fi> the land<WH0776> that is not cleansed<WH02891><WTH8794>, nor rained<WH01656> upon in the day<WH03117> of indignation<WH02195>.

<FI> There is<Fi> a conspiracy<WH07195> of her prophets<WH05030> in the midst<WH08432> thereof, like a roaring<WH07580><WTH8802> lion<WH0738> ravening<WH02963><WTH8802> the prey<WH02964>; they have devoured<WH0398><WTH8804> souls<WH05315>; they have taken<WH03947><WTH8799> the treasure<WH02633> and precious things<WH03366>; they have made her many<WH07235><WTH8689> widows<WH0490> in the midst<WH08432> thereof.

Her priests<WH03548> have violated<WH02554><WTH8804> my law<WH08451>, and have profaned<WH02490><WTH8762> mine holy things<WH06944>: they have put no difference<WH0914><WTH8689> between the holy<WH06944> and profane<WH02455>, neither have they shewed<WH03045><WTH8689> <FI>difference<Fi> between the unclean<WH02931> and the clean<WH02889>, and have hid<WH05956><WTH8689> their eyes<WH05869> from my sabbaths<WH07676>, and I am profaned<WH02490><WTH8735> among<WH08432> them. <RF>violated: Heb. offered violence to<Rf>

Her princes<WH08269> in the midst<WH07130> thereof <FI>are<Fi> like wolves<WH02061> ravening<WH02963><WTH8802> the prey<WH02964>, to shed<WH08210><WTH8800> blood<WH01818>, <FI>and<Fi> to destroy<WH06><WTH8763> souls<WH05315>, to get<WH01214><WTH8800> dishonest gain<WH01215>.

And her prophets<WH05030> have daubed<WH02902><WTH8804> them with untempered<WH08602> <FI>morter<Fi> , seeing<WH02374> vanity<WH07723>, and divining<WH07080><WTH8802> lies<WH03577> unto them, saying<WH0559><WTH8802>, Thus saith<WH0559><WTH8804> the Lord<WH0136> GOD<WH03069>, when the LORD<WH03068> hath not spoken<WH01696><WTH8765>.

The people<WH05971> of the land<WH0776> have used oppression<WH06231><WTH8804><WH06233>, and exercised<WH01497><WTH8804> robbery<WH01498>, and have vexed<WH03238><WTH8689> the poor<WH06041> and needy<WH034>: yea, they have oppressed<WH06231><WTH8804> the stranger<WH01616> wrongfully<WH04941>. <RF>oppression: or, deceit<Rf> <RF>wrongfully: Heb. without right<Rf>

And I sought<WH01245><WTH8762> for a man<WH0376> among them, that should make up<WH01443><WTH8802> the hedge<WH01447>, and stand<WH05975><WTH8802> in the gap<WH06556> before<WH06440> me for the land<WH0776>, that I should not destroy<WH07843><WTH8763> it: but I found<WH04672><WTH8804> none.

Therefore have I poured out<WH08210><WTH8799> mine indignation<WH02195> upon them; I have consumed<WH03615><WTH8765> them with the fire<WH0784> of my wrath<WH05678>: their own way<WH01870> have I recompensed<WH05414><WTH8804> upon their heads<WH07218>, saith<WH05002><WTH8803> the Lord<WH0136> GOD<WH03069>.<CM>
